title: Data Retention Schedule by Type
panelPrompt: Click a data type to see how long it is kept and what starts the clock.

image.style: flat vector schedule poster, clean document and clock pictograms, muted textbook palette
image.overall: A stacked-band poster showing how long four kinds of club data are kept, drawn as four full-width horizontal bands. The bands are ordered by retention length: the BOTTOM band is kept longest and the TOP band is kept in anonymised form only. The four printed band titles, and the ONLY text in the image, are, from BOTTOM to TOP: "Consent Forms", "Progress Records", "Contact Information", "Survey Responses".
image.layoutNotes: Draw the 4 bands as full-width horizontal strips stacked with a small uniform gap of plain background between each pair. Every band must span the SAME left and right edges (about 3% to 97% of the image width), so the overlay's hover zones line up exactly. No text other than the printed titles listed above. Each band carries its printed title in bold dark text at its LEFT end on a solid block of that band's accent colour, with simple flat pictograms to the right. Do NOT draw any durations, dates, month counts, or numbers anywhere -- the retention periods are supplied by the overlay.

zones.label: Consent Forms
zones.summary: Kept as long as the data they cover is retained.
facts: Signed or declined guardian consent forms
Retained alongside whatever data they authorise
Deleted only when the covered data is deleted

draw.position: The bottom band, roughly 76% to 96% down the image.
draw.visual: Solid blue title block at the left end. To its right: a document icon with a signature squiggle on it, linked by a short chain-link symbol to a small folder icon.

zones.label: Progress Records
zones.summary: Retained eighteen months after a student leaves.
facts: Clock starts the day a student stops attending
Deleted automatically once the window passes

draw.position: The second band from the bottom, roughly 52% to 74% down.
draw.visual: Solid green title block at the left end. To its right: a badge rosette icon, a small grid/checklist icon, and an hourglass. No numbers on any of them.

zones.label: Contact Information
zones.summary: Retained only while a family is actively enrolled.
facts: Removed promptly once a family is no longer active
Never kept 'just in case' of future re-enrolment

draw.position: The third band from the bottom, roughly 28% to 50% down.
draw.visual: Solid amber title block at the left end. To its right: an envelope icon and a simple person silhouette, with a small trash-bin icon at the right end of the band.

zones.label: Survey Responses
zones.summary: Kept in anonymised form only, indefinitely.
facts: Individual free-text responses are summarised and the originals discarded within 90 days
Anonymised summaries may be kept for year-over-year comparison
No names are ever attached to a retained summary

draw.position: The top band, roughly 4% to 26% down.
draw.visual: Solid violet title block at the left end. To its right: several small speech-bubble icons merging into one bar-chart icon, and a person silhouette with a line through it to suggest anonymisation.

quiz.question: Which data type is kept only while a family is actively enrolled?
Which data type is kept indefinitely, but only anonymised?
Which data type's deletion clock starts when a student stops attending?
